import pytest
from calendar_core.slots import Event, overlaps, free_slots

try:
    from calendar_core import find_meeting_time
except ImportError:
    from calendar_core.slots import find_meeting_time


def test_issue_example():
    """Example: find_meeting_time([[Event(540, 600)], [Event(600, 660)]], 30, 540, 720) returns (660, 690)."""
    result = find_meeting_time([[Event(540, 600)], [Event(600, 660)]], 30, 540, 720)
    assert result == (660, 690)  # 660 + 30 = 690


def test_issue_earliest_gap():
    """Return the earliest (start, start + duration) inside [day_start, day_end) where nobody has an event."""
    result = find_meeting_time([[Event(600, 660)]], 30, 540, 720)
    assert result == (540, 570)  # 540 + 30 = 570


def test_issue_half_open_start_at_end():
    """Events are half-open, so a meeting may start exactly when someone's event ends."""
    result = find_meeting_time([[Event(540, 600)]], 60, 540, 720)
    assert result == (600, 660)  # 600 + 60 = 660


def test_issue_no_time_returns_none():
    """Return None if there is no such time."""
    result = find_meeting_time([[Event(540, 720)]], 30, 540, 720)
    assert result is None  # busy 540-720 covers whole day, no 30-min gap


def test_issue_clipped_outside_day():
    """Events partly outside the day are clipped."""
    result = find_meeting_time([[Event(0, 560)], [Event(700, 900)]], 30, 540, 720)
    assert result == (560, 590)  # 560 + 30 = 590


def test_issue_unordered_overlapping_union():
    """Calendars is a list of calendars; each calendar is a list of Event in any order, possibly overlapping."""
    cals = [[Event(600, 660), Event(540, 600)], [Event(580, 620)]]
    result = find_meeting_time(cals, 30, 540, 720)
    assert result == (660, 690)  # 660 + 30 = 690


def test_issue_empty_calendars():
    """Return the earliest (start, start + duration) inside [day_start, day_end) where nobody has an event."""
    result = find_meeting_time([], 45, 540, 720)
    assert result == (540, 585)  # 540 + 45 = 585


def test_issue_zero_duration_raises():
    """Duration must be a positive integer, otherwise raise ValueError."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        find_meeting_time([[Event(540, 600)]], 0, 540, 720)  # 0 is not positive


def test_issue_negative_duration_raises():
    """Duration must be a positive integer, otherwise raise ValueError."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        find_meeting_time([[Event(540, 600)]], -30, 540, 720)  # -30 < 0


def test_issue_float_duration_raises():
    """Duration must be a positive integer, otherwise raise ValueError."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        find_meeting_time([[Event(540, 600)]], 30.5, 540, 720)  # 30.5 is not an int


def test_issue_exact_fit_at_day_end():
    """Return the earliest (start, start + duration) inside [day_start, day_end) where nobody has an event."""
    result = find_meeting_time([[Event(540, 690)]], 30, 540, 720)
    assert result == (690, 720)  # 690 + 30 = 720


def test_issue_just_over_gap_returns_none():
    """Return None if there is no such time."""
    result = find_meeting_time([[Event(540, 690)]], 31, 540, 720)
    assert result is None  # gap 720-690=30 < 31


def test_contract_overlaps_back_to_back():
    """Back-to-back events (one ends exactly when the next starts) do not overlap."""
    assert overlaps(Event(540, 600), Event(600, 660)) is False  # share 0 minutes


def test_contract_free_slots_min_minutes():
    """Only gaps of at least min_minutes are returned."""
    result = free_slots([Event(540, 600), Event(610, 660)], 540, 720, 30)
    assert result == [(660, 720)]  # gaps 610-600=10 filtered, 720-660=60 kept
